text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first three years spent with Epiphaneia
had come to an en—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO
OOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!!!
choice_data_list: (—This is no time to look back!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia was running on the course just a moment ago.
Yet the moment I took my eyes off her,
she vanished...!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text: If you're looking for Epi-san, I hear footsteps coming from over there.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
You might need an extra pair of hands...
Shall we go together?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hm, hm, hm-hmm♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you two!
Just in time!! Look at this!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It's the “Legendary Super-Charismatic Yakisoba Pan”!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right! This yakisoba pan
is so legendary that it glows golden♪
Pretty awesome, right!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Right~ It's amazing.
Though, Trainer, you can't even open your eyes, so...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, my bad, my bad!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Talk about lucky, though!
Apparently they hardllly ever get this in stock!
choice_data_list: Did you get it thanks to that voice of destiny?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I really am the best♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what it tastes like?!
Let's all eat it together!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Is it okay for me to have some too?
Thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Still...
is glowing bread really okay to eat?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Because I'm loved by destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Since it's the bread I picked out,
it's definitely gonna bring happiness to both of them!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"No, I'll make it happen!
—Follow me!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Even after the first three years come to an end,
nothing will change.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on too, dragged along by her whom destiny loves...
I will watch our expanding future unfold.
